theorems.statement: ∀ p q : ℝ, ∃ χ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (χ k)) ∧ (∀ k, tsupport (χ k) ⊆ Icc p q) ∧ ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Integrable g → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ α, χ k α * g α) atTop (𝓝 (∫ α in Ioo p q, g α))
